title: Abashaka Ukuri Bicisha Bugufi
intro: Mu gihugu cy’imbaraga n’ubupfumu bya kera, habayeho guhangana gukomeye. Uruhande rumwe rufite ububasha bw’ibimenyetso by’Imana, mu gihe urundi rugerageza guhuza n’ibidashoboka. Ingaruka zizahindura amateka iteka ryose. Ese ushobora kuvumbura abo babonye ukuri kw’ikirenga kandi bakicisha bugufi imbere yako?
clues: Twese twaguye mu cyunamo, ntitwashoboraga guhakana ukuri
Twamenye ko ibi bimenyetso byaturutse ku Mana Imwe y'Ukuri
Twari umuryango wa mbere wakiriye ukwemera mu buryo butangaje nk'ubwo
Twasezeranijwe paradizo nk'impongano yacu ku bw'imyizerere yacu
Imigozi yacu n'inkoni zacu byahindutse inzoka imbere y'amaso yacu, nyamara twahisemo kuyoboka

Urugendo rw'umuhanuzi uri mu ifi nini

arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
